1.ja: והד'א אלאמר אלד'י תצנעה להם. לתקדסהם
1.en: And this is the thing which you shall do for them, to consecrate them
1.he: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר-תַּעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם

1.en: that they may serve as imāms for Me
take a young bull from the cattle

2.en: and unleavened loaves kneaded with oil
and unleavened wafers spread with oil
from fine wheat flour you shall make them;

3.ja: ואגעלהא פי סלה ואחדה. וקדמהא פיהא
3.en: and place them in one basket, and present them in it
3.he: וְנָתַתָּ אוֹתָם עַל-סַל אֶחָד וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֹתָם בַּסָּל

3.en: together with the young bull and the two rams.

4.ja: וקדם הרון ובניה. אלי באב כ'בא אלמחצ'ר
4.en: Then bring Aaron and his sons forward to the entrance of the tent of the appointed gathering
4.he: וְאֶת-אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת-בָּנָיו תַּקְרִיב אֶל-פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד

5.en: and clothe Aaron with the tunic, and the robe
5.he: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֶת-אַהֲרֹן אֶת-הַכֻּתֹּנֶת וְאֵת מְעִיל הָאֵפֹד

5.en: and the breastpiece, and the ephod
and fasten him with its binding-straps.

6.en: And set the turban upon his head
and place the crown of holiness beneath the turban.

7.en: And take from the anointing oil
and pour it upon his head

9.en: And bind them with sashes — Aaron and his sons
and the imāmate shall be theirs as an ordinance forever
And complete the required duty of Aaron and the required duty of his sons.

10.ja: וקדם אלרת'. בין ידי כ'בא אלמחצ'ר
10.en: And bring the young bull forward before the tent of the appointed gathering

10.ja: ויסנד הרון ובניה. אידיהם עלי' ראסה
10.en: and Aaron and his sons shall lean their hands upon its head.
10.he: וְסָמַךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת-יְדֵיהֶם עַל-רֹאשׁ הַפָּר

11.en: at the entrance of the tent of the appointed gathering.

12.en: and place it upon the horns of the altar with your finger
and pour the remainder of it at the base of the altar.

13.en: And take from it the fat-membrane covering the belly
and the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys
13.he: וְאֵת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל-הַכָּבֵד וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת

13.en: with the fat that is upon them
and burn these upon the altar.

14.en: But the flesh of the young bull, and its hide, and its dung
burn with fire outside the camp

15.en: Then bring forward one of the rams

15.ja: ויסנד הרון ובניה. אידיהם עלי' ראסה
15.en: and Aaron and his sons shall lean their hands upon its head.

16.en: and sprinkle it upon the altar all around.

17.en: And cut it into its members
and wash its belly and its shanks
and add them upon the altar.

18.en: For it is an ascending-offering to God
it is an offering to God.

19.en: And bring forward the second ram

19.ja: ויסנד הרון ובניה. אידיהם עלי' ראסה
19.en: and Aaron and his sons shall lean their hands upon its head.
19.he: וְסָמַךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת-יְדֵיהֶם עַל-רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל

20.ja: וכד' מן דמה ואגעל. עלי' שחמה' אד'ן הרון
20.en: and take from its blood and place it upon the cartilage of the earlobe of Aaron
20.he: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִדָּמוֹ וְנָתַתָּה עַל-תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן אַהֲרֹן

20.en: and upon the cartilages of the earlobes of his sons on the right side
and upon the thumbs of their right hands

20.ja: ורש בקי אלדם . עלי' אלמד'בח מסתדירא
20.en: and sprinkle the remainder of the blood upon the altar all around.

21.ja: וכד' מן אלדם אלד'י עלי' אלמד'בח ומן דהן אלמסח
21.en: And take from the blood that is upon the altar and from the anointing oil
21.he: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִן-הַדָּם אֲשֶׁר עַל-הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה

21.ja: ואנצ'ח עלי' אלמד'בח ועלי' הרון ותיאבה ובניה. ות'יאב בניה מעה
21.en: and sprinkle it upon the altar and upon Aaron and his garments, and upon his sons and the garments of his sons with him
21.he: וְהִזֵּיתָ עַל-אַהֲרֹן וְעַל-בְּגָדָיו וְעַל-בָּנָיו וְעַל-בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ

21.ja: פיתקדס הו ות'יאבה. ובניה ות'יאב בניה מעה
21.en: so that he and his garments shall be consecrated, and his sons and the garments of his sons with him.
21.he: וְקָדַשׁ הוּא וּבְגָדָיו וּבָנָיו וּבִגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ

22.en: And take from the ram the fat and the fat-tail
and all the fat-membrane covering the belly

22.ja: וזאידה' אלכבד ואלכלותין. ואלשחם אלד'י עליהמא
22.en: and the appendage of the liver and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them
22.he: וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת-הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן

22.en: and the right shank — for it is the ram of completion.
22.he: וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין כִּי אֵיל מִלֻּאִים הוּא

23.ja: ורג'יף ומן כל נוע.רגיף אחד מן אלכ'בז
23.en: And from each kind — one loaf of bread
and one thick loaf with oil

23.ja: ורקאקה ממסוחה ואחדה. מן סל אלפטיר. אלד'י בין ידיה אללה
23.en: and one spread wafer — from the basket of unleavened bread that is before God.
23.he: וְרָקִיק אֶחָד מִסַּל הַמַּצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה

24.ja: וצייר אלגמיע. עלי' כפי הרון וכפי בניה
24.en: And place all of it upon the palms of Aaron and the palms of his sons
24.he: וְשַׂמְתָּ הַכֹּל--עַל כַּפֵּי אַהֲרֹן וְעַל כַּפֵּי בָנָיו

24.ja: וחרך ד'אלך תחריכא בין ידי אללה
24.en: and wave it in a waving motion before God.

25.en: Then take it from their hands

25.ja: וקתרה עלי' אלמד'בח מע אלצעידה. מקבול מרצ'י בין ידי אללה
25.en: and burn it upon the altar together with the ascending-offering — accepted and pleasing before God
25.he: וְהִקְטַרְתָּ הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל-הָעֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה

25.en: it is an offering to God.

26.ja: וכד' אלקץ. מן כבש אלכמאל אלד'י להרון
26.en: And take the breast from the ram of completion that belongs to Aaron
26.he: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת-הֶחָזֶה מֵאֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים אֲשֶׁר לְאַהֲרֹן

26.en: and wave it in a waving motion before God
and it shall be a portion for you.

27.en: And consecrate the breast of the waving and the shank of the elevation
27.he: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֵת חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה

27.en: that which was waved and that which was raised

27.ja: מן כבש אלכמאל. אלד'י להרון ולבניה
27.en: from the ram of completion that belongs to Aaron and to his sons.

28.en: And it shall be for Aaron and for his sons an ordinance forever

28.ja: כד'אך יכונא רפיעה מן בני אסראיל מן ד'באיח סלאמתהם
28.en: so shall they be an elevation from the sons of Israel from their peace-offerings
28.he: וּתְרוּמָה יִהְיֶה מֵאֵת בְּנֵי-יִשְׂרָאֵל מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיהֶם

28.en: they are their elevation to God.

29.ja: ות'יאב אלקדס אלד'י להרון. תכון לבניה מן בעדה
29.en: And the holy garments that belong to Aaron shall be for his sons after him
29.he: וּבִגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לְאַהֲרֹן יִהְיוּ לְבָנָיו אַחֲרָיו

29.en: that they may be anointed in them and that their required duty may be completed by them.

30.ja: סבעה' איאם. ילבסהם אלאמאם. בעדה מן בניה
30.en: Seven days shall the imām who comes after him from his sons wear them

30.ja: פיצלח אן ידכל אלי' כ'בא אלמחצ'ר. יכ'דם פי אלקדס
30.en: when he enters the tent of the appointed gathering to serve in the holy place.
30.he: אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא אֶל-אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ

31.en: And take the ram of completion
and cook its flesh in a consecrated place.

32.en: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram
together with the bread that is in the basket
at the entrance of the tent of the appointed meeting.

33.en: And those for whom atonement was made with them shall eat them
to complete their required duty and to consecrate them

33.ja: ואגנבי לא יאכל אד' הם קדסא
33.en: but a stranger shall not eat, for they are holy.

34.ja: ואן בקי מן לחם אלכמאל. ומן אלכ'בז אלי' אלצבאח
34.en: And if any of the flesh of the completion-offering or of the bread remains until the morning
it shall be burned with fire — it shall not be eaten

35.en: And do thus for Aaron and his sons
according to all that I have commanded you
seven days you shall complete their required duty.

36.ja: ורת' אלד'כוה תצנעה כל יום לאלג'פראן
36.en: And a young bull of the purification-offering you shall make each day for atonement
and thereby purify the altar, and seek atonement at it
and anoint it and consecrate it.

37.en: Seven days you shall seek atonement at it and consecrate it
37.he: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תְּכַפֵּר עַל-הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ

37.en: and the altar shall become of the especial class of the most holy things

37.ja: כל מן דנא בשי מנהא תקדס
37.en: whoever approaches anything of it shall be consecrated.

38.en: And this is what you shall offer upon the altar

38.ja: חמלין אבני סנה. פי כל יום דאימא
38.en: two yearling lambs, each day, continually.

39.en: One of them in the morning
and the other between the two sunsets.
39.he: וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם

40.ja: ועשר סמד. מלתות ברבע קסט מן דהן זיתון מדקוק
40.en: And a tenth-measure of fine flour kneaded with a quarter of a qisṭ of pressed olive oil
40.he: וְעִשָּׂרֹן סֹלֶת בָּלוּל בְּשֶׁמֶן כָּתִית רֶבַע הַהִין

40.ja: ומזאג רבע קסט כ'מר. מע כל חמל
40.en: and a libation of a quarter of a qisṭ of wine — with each lamb.

41.en: And when you offer the second between the two sunsets
41.he: וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם

41.en: as the gift-offering of the morning and its libation you shall make it
accepted and pleasing; an offering to God.

42.en: A perpetual ascending-offering for your generations

42.ja: ענד באב כ'בא אלמחצ'ר בין ידי אללה
42.en: at the entrance of the tent of the appointed gathering before God
where I shall be present for you there, and shall address you there.
42.he: אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לָכֶם שָׁמָּה לְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ שָׁם

43.en: And when I am present there for the sons of Israel
the house shall be consecrated by My light.

44.en: And I shall consecrate by it the tent of the appointed gathering and the altar
and I shall consecrate Aaron and his sons that they may serve as imāms for Me.

45.ja: ואסכן נורי פי מא בין בני אסראיל
45.en: And I shall make My light dwell among the sons of Israel
and I shall be their God.

46.en: And they shall know that I am God their Lord
who brought them out from the land of Egypt
that I might make My light dwell among them
I am God their Lord — I shall fulfil this.
